origin.description: Trims to a display width. C0 controls count as zero width. The cut is the wrap routine with no indent.
origin.usage: strtrim_ctl(x, width, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), ctl = "all", normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE), carry = getOption("fansi.carry", FALSE), terminate = getOption("fansi.terminate", TRUE))
origin.details: Trims to a display width. C0 controls count as zero width. The cut is the wrap routine with no indent. An omitted wrap width is 72, which is 0.9 times the default R width of 80.

translation.description: Trims to a display width. C0 controls count as zero width. The cut is the wrap routine with no indent.
translation.usage: strtrim_ctl(x, width, warn=None, ctl="all", normalize=None, carry=None, terminate=None)
translation.details: Trims to a display width. C0 controls count as zero width. The cut is the wrap routine with no indent. An omitted wrap width is 72. A string is one element. None is a missing string. Dotted R names are written with underscores.
translation.example:
from fansi.strtrim_ctl import strtrim_ctl
print(strtrim_ctl("\033[42mHello world\033[m", 6, warn=False)[0])
